explanation: A three-year adjustment programme has to be carried by a government that survives it, and Portugal had one. The coalition elected in June 2011 was still in office in May 2014, and it left the programme without the precautionary credit line, which was its own decision rather than the lenders'. The atlas argues the politics rather than the economics. A caretaker government of a party that then lost signed the memorandum. This election supplied a majority that had campaigned on carrying it out and had four years to do so.
